name: sumi
description: A text-first blog theme under 13.37 KB with no requests, JavaScript or trackers of its own. System fonts, monospace dates, hairline rows and one vermilion accent.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: Light, dark, or follow the visitor's system. There is no visitor toggle: it needs JavaScript.

show_theme_line.title: Show the theme line
show_theme_line.description: Show the footer line about the theme's size and requests

show_home_byline.title: Show the byline on the homepage
show_home_byline.description: The 'by <author> · rss' line under the tagline.

home_list.title: Homepage post list
home_list.description: Show a summary line under each post, or titles only.

home_title.title: Homepage heading
home_title.description: auto: tagline, or the site name when there is none. tagline: only when a tagline is set. hidden: no visible heading.

show_credit.title: Show the footer credit
show_credit.description: Show the credit after the copyright

newsletter_form.title: Newsletter form
newsletter_form.description: Slug of a Hatamoto form (Forms > New > Newsletter signup). Leave empty to show no subscribe block. The form must have email as its only required field.

newsletter_position.title: Newsletter position
newsletter_position.description: footer: top of the footer on every page. above_posts / below_posts: around the homepage post list (other pages keep the footer position).

newsletter_text.title: Newsletter text
newsletter_text.description: The sentence above the field. Empty: no sentence.
newsletter_text.default: Get new posts by email. No more than one a week.

newsletter_placeholder.title: Newsletter placeholder
newsletter_placeholder.description: The hint inside the email field.
